quick.summary: Why your design work gets ignored, and how to focus on what matters.
quick.takeaway: Fix the biggest risk to the business first, then worry about the details.

beats.line: We fixed the settings menu, but leadership ignored it. Why?
Imagine painting a house while the roof is on fire.
The new paint looks nice, but the house will still burn down.
Your settings menu is the paint. The business needs a working roof.
So we should find out what the business is actually worried about?
Exactly. Look for the biggest risk to the product right now.
Can I just say solving the real problem?
So if sales are dropping, I focus design on the buying steps.
Now you have their full attention.

quiz.question: The leadership team seems bored by your redesign. What should you do?
options: Find out what their biggest business risk is right now.
Make the presentation more visually engaging.
Explain the user research in more detail.
Show them the old design for contrast.
quiz.explanation: To get alignment, design must focus on the most urgent problem the business is facing.

quiz.question: A well crafted design is useful even if it does not solve the main business problem.
quiz.explanation: If the business is failing in one area, polishing an unrelated feature is like painting a burning house.
